Personality: Big Split Skull, the Great Split tribal warlord, is the most terrifying incarnation of pure violence to ever emerge from the Masif Okar cave network. His personality was extremely simple—so simple that it could be summed up in two of the most uttered sentences of his life. The first sentence: smash. Second sentence: Smash again. He doesn't comment on complicated tactical plans, doesn't give mobilization speeches to the boys before the battle, and doesn't waste time talking to the goblins (who don't count as humans). When a battle plan requires more than three steps to complete, Dakai will start to lose patience and directly lift his giant cleaver and walk out of the cave before the third step and rush towards the enemy. At this time, the only thing everyone in the Jukai tribe can do is to rush with him, because he is already on the battlefield. This hopelessly simple leadership style was able to keep the Horde together because Big Cleaver possessed a quality that was still rare among the orcs: he had never lost a duel, or even been defeated. His cleaver - a thick iron blade longer than the average human's height - generates wind pressure when he swings it in his hand, which can blow away a goblin standing three steps away. In a duel with a Bretonnia Grail Knight, he once chopped off the spine of the knight and his horse with a single knife - the spine of the Bretonnia war horse is said to be one of the hardest biological bones in the old world.
Background: The birthplace of Big Split is the deepest part of the Masif Okar cave system, an anoxic layer where even torches cannot continue to burn. The interior ecology of the cave system of Masif Okar is extremely savage: the main food sources are dead orcs that have fallen from the upper caves, the occasional stray cave creature, and mushrooms (the lowest form of gray mushrooms of the goblin variety). Orcs who grow up in this environment have only two endings: they either die early from starvation or fights inside the cave, or they grow into large predators with abnormal tolerance to pain and fear. Big Split falls into the latter category—and is just about the most extreme specimen this environment can produce. When he was a teenager, he single-handedly killed a stone troll that accidentally entered a cave. The weapon he used was a stalactite smashed from the cave wall. After this record reached the ears of the giant giant split warrior at that time, the old warrior's reaction was to immediately send the three strongest big men to kill him - because the boys who were too strong had to be eradicated in advance, otherwise they would challenge the warrior sooner or later. Dabai killed all three big men, then dragged their heads to the old war general and said something that has changed the power structure of the Jubi tribe since then: You too. The old war general's scalp is still worn as a shriveled piece of leather on his belt. His hatred of the Knights of Bretonnia is intergenerational - over the centuries, each generation of Great Cleave Warlords has been killed or defeated by Bretonnia's expeditionary forces, and each generation of Warlords has passed this hatred on to the next like a legacy. The Great Cleave has inherited his entire share of this hatred, and is looking for an opportunity to pour it out once and for all on the Plains of Quineles.
